trap.label: particípio -ing
trap.wrong: Opening with a welcome, sets the tone.
trap.right: Opening with a welcome, set the tone.
trap.why: Em instruções, o particípio inicial precisa de um imperativo/sujeito coerente. O brasileiro adiciona -s ou omite o sujeito.

fix.wrong: Having circulate the agenda, I began.
fix.right: Having circulated the agenda, I began.

fix.wrong: Opening with a welcome, sets the tone.
fix.right: Opening with a welcome, set the tone.

fix.wrong: Having circulated the agenda, the agenda began.
fix.right: Having circulated the agenda, I began.

rewrite.prompt: Particípio: “After I had circulated the agenda, I began.”
rewrite.answer: Having circulated the agenda, I began.

rewrite.prompt: Particípio negativo: “Because he had not been told, he was surprised.”
rewrite.answer: Not having been told, he was surprised.

rewrite.prompt: Particípio: “While I opened with a welcome, I set the tone.”
rewrite.answer: Opening with a welcome, I set the tone.
